lotes: flat barbell bench press: lying on a flat bench, feet on the floor, gripping a loaded barbell slightly wider than shoulders, bar lowered to the mid-chest (nipple line), elbows about 45 degrees from the torso
incline barbell bench press: lying on a bench inclined about 30 degrees, bar lowered to the upper chest
decline barbell bench press: lying on a decline bench with legs hooked under the pads, bar lowered to the lower chest
flat dumbbell bench press: lying on a flat bench, one dumbbell in each hand pressed up above the chest, arms almost straight
incline dumbbell press: lying on a bench inclined about 30 degrees, dumbbells at upper-chest level with elbows bent
flat dumbbell fly: lying on a flat bench, arms opened wide to the sides with a slight elbow bend, dumbbells at chest height
dumbbell pullover: lying on a flat bench, holding one dumbbell with both hands behind the head, arms extended overhead
cable crossover: standing between the two high pulleys of a cable crossover machine, slight forward lean, pulling both handles down and together in front of the hips
pec deck machine fly: seated upright in a pec deck machine, bringing the two padded arms together in front of the chest
seated chest press machine: seated with back on the pad, pushing the handles forward at chest height
push-up: body in a straight plank on hands and toes, chest lowered close to the floor, hands slightly wider than shoulders
chest dip on parallel bars: supporting the body on two parallel bars, torso leaning forward, elbows bent to 90 degrees, legs bent behind
Smith machine bench press: lying on a flat bench inside a Smith machine (barbell fixed on vertical rails), bar lowered to the mid-chest
resistance band chest press: standing, a resistance band anchored behind at chest height, pressing both band handles straight forward
pull-up: hanging from an overhead bar with an overhand grip wider than shoulders, pulled up with the chin above the bar, rear three-quarter view
assisted pull-up machine: kneeling on the padded counterweight platform of an assisted pull-up machine, pulling up with an overhand grip
lat pulldown: seated at a cable pulldown machine, thighs under the pads, pulling a wide bar down to the upper chest, rear three-quarter view
close neutral-grip lat pulldown: seated at a cable pulldown machine, pulling a V-handle (palms facing each other) down to the upper chest, rear three-quarter view
bent-over barbell row: hinged at the hips with the torso at about 45 degrees, knees slightly bent, back flat, pulling the barbell to the lower ribs
one-arm dumbbell row: one knee and one hand resting on a flat bench, back flat, the other arm pulling a dumbbell up to the hip
seated cable row: seated on a low cable row bench, feet on the foot platform, torso upright, pulling a V-handle to the abdomen
seated row machine: seated with the chest against the pad, pulling both handles back, elbows close to the body
chest-supported dumbbell row: lying face down on an incline bench, a dumbbell in each hand pulled up beside the ribs
T-bar row: standing over a barbell anchored at one end (landmine), hinged at the hips, pulling a V-handle under the bar up to the chest
standing straight-arm cable pulldown: facing a high pulley, slight hip hinge, arms almost straight pushing a straight bar down to the thighs
TRX inverted row: holding TRX suspension straps, body leaning back in a straight line with heels on the floor, chest pulled up to the hands
inverted row: lying under a barbell set in a rack at waist height, body straight, heels on the floor, chest pulled up to the bar
resistance band seated row: seated on the floor with legs straight, a resistance band looped around the feet, rowing the handles to the waist
back extension: hips on the pad of a 45-degree hyperextension bench, ankles locked, torso raised up in line with the legs
dumbbell shrug: standing, a dumbbell in each hand with arms straight at the sides, shoulders shrugged up toward the ears
standing barbell overhead press: standing upright, barbell pressed from the shoulders to overhead with arms almost locked
seated dumbbell shoulder press: seated on an upright bench, dumbbells pressed overhead from shoulder height
Arnold press: seated on an upright bench, dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing the body, rotating the palms forward while pressing up
seated shoulder press machine: seated with the back on the pad, pressing the handles overhead
dumbbell lateral raise: standing, raising a dumbbell in each hand out to the sides up to shoulder height, slight elbow bend
cable lateral raise: standing side-on to a low cable pulley, raising a single handle across the body and out to the side up to shoulder height with the far arm
dumbbell front raise: standing, raising dumbbells straight in front of the body up to shoulder height
bent-over dumbbell reverse fly: torso hinged forward almost parallel to the floor, raising the dumbbells out to the sides
reverse pec deck: seated facing the chest pad of a pec deck machine, pulling the handles backward and apart with straight arms
cable face pull: standing facing a high cable pulley with a rope attachment, pulling the rope toward the face with elbows high and wide
landmine press: standing, one end of a barbell anchored in a floor landmine, pressing the other end up and forward with one hand
band pull-apart: standing, arms straight in front at shoulder height, pulling a resistance band apart out to the sides
standing barbell curl: standing, underhand grip, elbows fixed at the sides, curling the barbell up halfway
standing dumbbell curl: standing, palms facing up, curling the dumbbells up with elbows at the sides
hammer curl: standing, neutral grip with palms facing each other, curling the dumbbells up
incline dumbbell curl: seated leaning back on a bench inclined about 45 degrees, arms hanging behind the torso, curling the dumbbells
barbell preacher curl: seated at a preacher bench, upper arms resting on the angled pad, curling a straight barbell up
standing cable curl: facing a low cable pulley, curling a straight bar up with elbows at the sides
concentration curl: seated on a flat bench, elbow braced against the inner thigh, curling a single dumbbell
biceps curl machine: seated with the upper arms on the machine pad, curling the handles up
rope triceps pushdown: standing facing a high cable pulley, elbows tucked at the sides, pushing a rope down to the thighs and spreading its ends
straight-bar triceps pushdown: standing facing a high cable pulley, elbows tucked at the sides, pushing a short straight bar down to the thighs
seated overhead dumbbell triceps extension: seated upright, one dumbbell held with both hands behind the head, elbows pointing up, extending the arms overhead
overhead cable triceps extension: standing facing away from a cable pulley, rope held behind the head, elbows pointing forward, extending the arms overhead
lying barbell triceps extension (skull crusher): lying on a flat bench, upper arms vertical, barbell lowered toward the forehead by bending the elbows
close-grip bench press: lying on a flat bench, hands shoulder-width apart, elbows tucked, barbell lowered to the lower chest
dumbbell triceps kickback: bent over with one hand and knee on a bench, upper arm parallel to the floor, forearm extended straight back
triceps dip on parallel bars: supporting the body on two parallel bars, torso upright, elbows pointing back and bent to 90 degrees
seated wrist curl: seated, forearms resting on the thighs with palms facing up, curling the dumbbells up with the wrists only
seated wrist extension: seated, forearms resting on the thighs with palms facing down, lifting the dumbbells with the wrists only
reverse barbell curl: standing, overhand grip (palms down), curling the barbell up with elbows at the sides
dead hang: hanging from an overhead pull-up bar, arms straight, feet off the floor, body relaxed
plate pinch hold: standing upright, in each hand two smooth weight plates pinched together between fingers and thumb, arms straight at the sides
barbell back squat: barbell resting across the upper back behind the neck, standing freely with no bench or box, at the bottom of the squat with thighs parallel to the floor, chest up
barbell front squat: barbell resting on the front of the shoulders with elbows high, standing freely, deep squat with torso upright
goblet squat: holding one kettlebell at the chest with both hands, deep squat with torso upright
45-degree leg press: seated reclined in a leg press machine, feet on the platform, knees bent near 90 degrees
hack squat machine: back against the angled padded sled, shoulders under the pads, squatting down with thighs near parallel
Smith machine squat: standing inside a Smith machine, bar on the upper back, squatting with thighs parallel to the floor
leg extension machine: seated, ankles behind the lower pad, extending the knees to lift the legs forward
dumbbell lunge: dumbbells hanging at the sides, long forward step, front thigh parallel to the floor, back knee close to the floor
Bulgarian split squat: rear foot resting on a bench behind, dumbbells at the sides, front leg bent with thigh parallel to the floor
dumbbell step-up: stepping up onto a box with one foot, dumbbells hanging at the sides
bodyweight squat: no equipment, arms extended forward for balance, thighs parallel to the floor
TRX squat: holding the TRX suspension strap handles in front with arms extended, sitting back into a deep squat
barbell Romanian deadlift: hips pushed back, knees slightly bent, back flat, barbell lowered to mid-shin close to the legs
dumbbell Romanian deadlift: hips pushed back, knees slightly bent, back flat, a dumbbell in each hand lowered to mid-shin in front of the legs
lying leg curl machine: lying face down on the machine, curling the ankle pad toward the glutes
seated leg curl machine: seated with the thigh pad locked, pushing the lower pad down and back under the seat
Nordic hamstring curl: kneeling on a pad with the ankles held down, body straight from knees to head, slowly leaning forward
barbell good morning: barbell on the upper back, knees slightly bent, hinging forward at the hips until the torso is nearly parallel to the floor, back flat
single-leg dumbbell Romanian deadlift: balancing on one leg, the other leg extended straight back, torso tilted forward, dumbbell in the opposite hand
TRX hamstring curl: lying on the back with the heels in TRX foot cradles, hips lifted, curling the heels toward the glutes
barbell hip thrust: upper back resting on a bench, padded barbell across the hips, hips driven up to full extension, knees at 90 degrees
hip thrust machine: upper back on the machine pad, padded belt over the hips, hips driven up to full extension
glute bridge: lying on the back on the floor, knees bent, feet flat, hips lifted up
cable glute kickback: standing facing a low cable pulley with an ankle strap, kicking one straight leg back
seated hip abduction machine: seated, pushing the knees outward against the side pads
banded hip abduction: seated on the floor leaning back on the hands, a mini resistance band around the thighs above the knees, pushing the knees apart
cable pull-through: facing away from a low cable pulley, rope held between the legs, hinging forward then driving the hips forward to stand
dumbbell reverse lunge: dumbbells at the sides, stepping one leg back, front thigh parallel to the floor
standing calf raise machine: shoulders under the pads, balls of the feet on the block, rising up on the toes
seated calf raise machine: seated, knees under the pad, balls of the feet on the block, rising up on the toes
calf press on a 45-degree leg press: seated reclined, legs straight, balls of the feet on the bottom edge of the platform, pushing with the ankles
single-leg calf raise: standing on one foot on the edge of a step, one hand on a wall for balance, rising up on the toes
Smith machine calf raise: standing inside a Smith machine, bar on the upper back, balls of the feet on a raised block, rising up on the toes
forearm plank: on the forearms and toes, body in a straight line from head to heels, side view
side plank: supported on one forearm and the side of one foot, hips lifted, body in a straight line
floor crunch: lying on the back, knees bent, feet flat, hands beside the head, curling the shoulders off the floor
kneeling cable crunch: kneeling facing a high cable pulley, rope held beside the head, curling the torso down toward the knees
hanging leg raise: hanging from a pull-up bar, raising straight legs up to horizontal
dead bug: lying on the back, one arm extended overhead and the opposite leg extended straight, the other arm and leg pointing up with knee bent at 90 degrees
bird dog: on hands and knees, extending one arm straight forward and the opposite leg straight back, back flat
Pallof press: standing side-on to a cable pulley set at chest height, pressing the handle straight out in front of the chest with both hands, resisting rotation
ab wheel rollout: kneeling, both hands on an ab wheel rolled far forward, body stretched long and straight
cable woodchop: standing side-on to a high cable pulley, rotating the torso and pulling the handle diagonally down across the body with both hands
reverse crunch: lying on the back, knees bent, lifting the hips off the floor and curling the knees toward the chest
TRX knee tuck: in a push-up plank with both feet in the TRX foot cradles, pulling the knees in toward the chest
conventional barbell deadlift: feet hip-width, hands just outside the knees, back flat, bar lifted from the floor to knee height
sumo deadlift: very wide stance with toes pointed out, hands gripping the bar inside the knees, torso upright, lifting the bar from the floor
two-hand kettlebell swing: hips fully extended, standing tall, arms straight holding the kettlebell at chest height
dumbbell thruster: rising from a squat while pressing the dumbbells from the shoulders to overhead
burpee: shown in the plank phase, hands on the floor and chest lowered close to the floor, legs straight behind, ready to jump up
farmer's walk: walking upright mid-stride, holding a heavy dumbbell in each hand at the sides
barbell power clean, catch position: barbell racked on the front of the shoulders, elbows high and forward, in a quarter squat
kettlebell Turkish get-up, bridge phase: supported on one straight arm and both feet, hips lifted high, the other arm pointing straight up holding a kettlebell overhead
plate-loaded incline chest press machine: seated with the back on the reclined pad of the machine, gripping the two handles at upper-chest level and pressing them up and forward
Smith machine incline bench press: lying on a bench inclined about 30 degrees inside a Smith machine (barbell fixed on vertical rails), bar lowered to the upper chest
incline dumbbell fly: lying on a bench inclined about 30 degrees, arms opened wide to the sides with a slight elbow bend, dumbbells at upper-chest height
low-to-high cable fly: standing between the two low pulleys of a cable crossover machine, arms slightly bent, sweeping both handles up and together in front of the upper chest
chin-up: hanging from an overhead bar with an underhand grip (palms facing the body) at shoulder width, pulled up with the chin above the bar, front three-quarter view

underhand-grip lat pulldown: seated at a cable pulldown machine with the thighs under the pads, straight bar held with an underhand grip (palms facing the body) at shoulder width, bar pulled down to the upper chest
single-arm cable pulldown: kneeling on one knee facing a high cable pulley, pulling a single D-handle down with one arm to the side of the chest, elbow driving down toward the hip

single-arm seated cable row: seated at a low cable row station with the feet on the platform, torso upright, pulling one D-handle to the side of the waist with one arm, the other hand resting on the thigh
Pendlay row: torso bent forward parallel to the floor, back flat, knees slightly bent, overhand grip, loaded barbell pulled from the floor up to the lower chest
barbell shrug: standing upright, barbell held in front of the thighs with an overhand grip and straight arms, shoulders lifted up toward the ears
trap bar deadlift: standing inside a hexagonal trap bar, gripping its two side handles with a neutral grip, back flat, hips and knees bent, lifting the bar from the floor to knee height
barbell upright row: standing upright, overhand grip at shoulder width, barbell pulled up close to the body to lower-chest height with the elbows high and out to the sides
seated Smith machine shoulder press: seated on an upright bench inside a Smith machine (barbell fixed on vertical rails), bar in front of the face at chin level, pressing it overhead
seated lateral raise machine: seated in the machine with the arms bent and the outside of the forearms against the side pads, raising the elbows out to shoulder height
reverse cable fly: standing between the two high pulleys of a cable crossover machine, cables crossed in front of the body, pulling both straight arms out wide to the sides at shoulder height
cable front raise: standing facing away from a low cable pulley, the cable passing between the legs, raising a short straight bar with straight arms in front of the body to shoulder height
Bayesian cable curl: standing facing away from a low cable pulley in a staggered stance, one arm extended behind the torso holding a D-handle, curling it forward while the elbow stays behind the body
dumbbell spider curl: lying chest-down on a bench inclined about 45 degrees, arms hanging straight down in front of the bench, curling the dumbbells up
cable rope hammer curl: standing facing a low cable pulley, holding both ends of a rope with a neutral grip (palms facing each other), elbows at the sides, curling it up
EZ-bar curl: standing, angled underhand grip on a zig-zag shaped EZ curl bar, elbows fixed at the sides, curling the bar up halfway
single-arm cable triceps pushdown: standing facing a high cable pulley, one elbow tucked at the side, pushing a single D-handle down until the arm is straight
lying dumbbell triceps extension: lying on a flat bench, upper arms vertical, two dumbbells held with a neutral grip lowered beside the head by bending the elbows
seated dip machine: seated upright in a triceps dip machine, gripping the two handles at the sides of the body, pushing them down until the arms are straight
bench dip: hands on the edge of a flat bench behind the body, legs extended forward with the heels on the floor, body lowered with the elbows bent to 90 degrees and pointing back
pendulum squat machine: standing on the angled foot platform, shoulders under the pads and back against the swinging back pad, deep squat with the knees travelling well forward
seated horizontal leg press machine: seated upright with the back against the backrest, feet on a vertical platform in front, knees bent near 90 degrees, pushing the platform away
barbell lunge: barbell resting across the upper back (not on the neck), long forward step, torso upright, front thigh parallel to the floor, back knee close to the floor
sissy squat: on the balls of the feet, one hand holding a post for balance, knees pushed far forward and down toward the floor while the body leans back in a straight line from knees to head
standing single-leg curl machine: standing upright with the torso against the machine pad, curling one ankle pad up behind toward the glutes
Smith machine Romanian deadlift: standing inside a Smith machine (barbell fixed on vertical rails), hips pushed back, knees slightly bent, back flat, bar lowered close to the legs to mid-shin
Smith machine hip thrust: upper back resting on a flat bench placed inside a Smith machine, padded bar across the hips, hips driven up to full extension, knees at 90 degrees
glute kickback machine: torso supported on the chest pad, hands on the handles, one foot on the footplate, kicking that leg straight back and up
standing cable hip abduction: standing side-on to a low cable pulley with the strap on the outer ankle, one hand on the machine for balance, lifting the straight leg out to the side
dumbbell sumo squat: very wide stance with the toes pointed out, one dumbbell held vertically by one end with both hands hanging between the legs, deep squat with the torso upright
standing dumbbell calf raise: balls of the feet on a raised step, a dumbbell in each hand at the sides, rising up on the toes
seated ab crunch machine: seated with the upper chest against the pads, hands on the handles, curling the torso forward and down
captain's chair knee raise: back against the pad of a vertical knee raise station, forearms resting on the arm pads, legs hanging, knees raised up to the chest
Russian twist: seated on the floor, torso leaning back about 45 degrees, feet lifted off the floor with the knees bent, hands clasped together and rotated to one side of the hips
dumbbell side bend: standing upright, one dumbbell hanging in one hand at the side, the other hand behind the head, bending the torso sideways toward the dumbbell
lying leg raise: lying on the back on the floor, hands flat at the sides, straight legs raised up to vertical
seated hip adduction machine: seated upright, the inner side of the knees against the two pads, squeezing the legs together from a wide position

standing cable hip adduction: standing side-on to a low cable pulley with the strap on the inner ankle of the leg nearest the machine, one hand on the machine for balance, pulling that straight leg across in front of the other leg

banded standing hip adduction: standing side-on to a resistance band anchored low at the side, band looped around the inner ankle, one hand on a post for balance, pulling the straight leg in across the body

side-lying hip adduction: lying on one side on the floor, head resting on the bent lower arm, top leg bent with its foot flat on the floor in front of the knee, lifting the straight bottom leg up off the floor
Copenhagen plank: side plank on one forearm, the top leg resting on a flat bench by the inside of the knee, the bottom leg hanging free under the bench, hips lifted so the body forms a straight line
Cossack squat: very wide stance, shifting the weight to one side into a deep one-leg squat while the other leg stays straight with the toes pointing up, arms extended forward for balance
dumbbell side lunge: a dumbbell in each hand, long step out to the side, that knee bent with the hips pushed back, the other leg straight, torso upright
isometric adductor ball squeeze: lying on the back on the floor, knees bent and feet flat, squeezing a soft exercise ball between the knees
decline push-up: feet raised on a flat bench behind, hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line, chest lowered close to the floor
decline dumbbell press: lying on a decline bench with the legs hooked under the pads, dumbbells pressed up above the lower chest, arms almost straight
lying cable fly: lying on a flat bench placed between the two low pulleys of a cable crossover machine, a handle in each hand, arms opened wide to the sides with a slight elbow bend
dumbbell squeeze press: lying on a flat bench, two dumbbells held with a neutral grip and pressed firmly against each other above the mid-chest, arms bent
seal row: lying face down on a high flat bench raised on blocks, arms hanging straight down, pulling a barbell up from below toward the underside of the bench

Meadows row: staggered stance side-on to a barbell anchored in a floor landmine, torso bent forward, one hand gripping the loaded end of the bar overhand and pulling it up beside the hip, the other forearm resting on the front knee
rack pull: standing inside a power rack, loaded barbell lifted off safety pins set just below the knees, back flat, shown at mid-thigh with the hips driving forward
upper back, lower back and glutes
plate-loaded lat pulldown machine: seated with the thighs under the pads, pulling two independent handles down from overhead to shoulder level
seated barbell overhead press: seated on an upright bench, barbell pressed from the upper chest to overhead, bar passing in front of the face (not behind the neck)
dumbbell Y raise: lying chest-down on a bench inclined about 30 degrees, raising light dumbbells with straight arms forward and up into a Y shape, thumbs up
single-arm kettlebell overhead press: standing upright, kettlebell resting on the back of the forearm, pressing it straight overhead with one arm, the other hand on the hip
resistance band lateral raise: standing on the middle of a resistance band, holding its two ends and raising both arms out to the sides to shoulder height
single-arm dumbbell preacher curl: seated at a preacher bench, one upper arm resting on the angled pad, curling a dumbbell up
Zottman curl: standing, elbows at the sides, dumbbells at the top of the curl turned palms down (overhand), about to be lowered slowly
high cable curl: standing between the two high pulleys of a cable crossover machine, arms out to the sides at shoulder height, curling both handles toward the head (double-biceps pose)
TRX biceps curl: leaning back holding the TRX handles with palms up, body straight, heels on the floor, curling the hands toward the forehead
diamond push-up: body in a straight plank on the toes, hands together under the chest forming a diamond with the thumbs and index fingers, elbows bent close to the body
cable triceps kickback: bent forward at the hips facing a low cable pulley, upper arm held parallel to the floor, extending the forearm straight back while holding the cable
seated triceps extension machine: seated, upper arms resting on the angled pad, pushing the handles down and forward until the elbows are straight
resistance band overhead triceps extension: standing on one end of a band, holding the other end with both hands behind the head, elbows pointing up, extending the arms overhead
belt squat machine: standing on the machine platform with a hip belt attached to the lever below, hands on the front handles, torso upright, squatting with the thighs parallel to the floor
dumbbell walking lunge: side view, walking forward mid-stride, dumbbells at the sides, front thigh parallel to the floor, back knee near the floor, torso upright
pistol squat: deep squat on one leg, the other leg held straight out in front parallel to the floor, arms extended forward for balance
wall sit: back flat against a wall, thighs parallel to the floor, knees at 90 degrees, hands resting on the thighs
glute-ham raise machine: kneeling with the thighs on the curved pad and the ankles locked behind the rollers, body straight from knees to head, raising the torso by bending the knees
stability ball hamstring curl: lying on the back, heels on a large exercise ball, hips lifted, curling the ball toward the glutes
stiff-leg barbell deadlift: legs almost straight, hinging at the hips with a flat back, barbell lowered toward the feet in front of the shins
wrist roller: standing, arms held straight out in front at shoulder height, both hands on a short handle, twisting the wrists to roll up a cord with a small weight plate hanging from it
single-leg glute bridge: lying on the back, one knee bent with the foot flat on the floor, the other leg extended straight up in the air, hips lifted
glute-focused 45-degree hyperextension: on a 45-degree back extension bench, hips over the pad, upper back slightly rounded, feet turned out, raising the torso by squeezing the glutes
banded clamshell: lying on one side, knees bent at 90 degrees with the feet together, a mini band around the thighs above the knees, opening the top knee upward
quadruped donkey kick: on hands and knees, back flat, kicking one bent leg up behind with the sole of the foot facing the ceiling
hollow body hold: lying on the back with the lower back pressed into the floor, shoulders and straight legs lifted slightly off the floor, arms extended overhead, body in a shallow banana shape
mountain climbers: high plank on straight arms, one knee driven toward the chest while the other leg stays extended back
V-up: balancing on the glutes, straight legs and straight arms raised to meet above the hips, the body forming a V shape
bicycle crunch: lying on the back, hands beside the head, shoulders lifted, twisting one elbow toward the opposite bent knee while the other leg extends
decline bench crunch: lying on a decline bench with the feet hooked under the pads, hands beside the head, curling the torso up
donkey calf raise machine: bent forward at the hips with the lower back under the machine pad, hands on the handles, balls of the feet on the block, rising up on the toes
behind-the-back barbell wrist curl: standing upright, barbell held behind the body at arms length with the palms facing back, curling the bar up with the wrists only
sled push: leaning forward at about 45 degrees, arms extended gripping the tall poles of a loaded weight sled, driving it forward mid-stride on artificial turf
